name: @dp/gnosis
description: Retrieval over a curated markdown atom vault. Liftable unit: code here, vault at dp-gnosis/vault/, cache at dp-gnosis/cache/.
comment:files: What a fresh install must carry to RUN, not to be developed. `profiles/` ships because a profile is resolved at RUNTIME by path (paths.ts:profilesDir), and `golden/` ships with it because every shipped profile names `goldIdsPath: "../golden"` — the gold source ingest breaks exact-body dedupe ties against. Absent, `ingest` REFUSES (goldenIds.ts:sourceError) rather than deduping gold-blind, so a fresh install could not build its first index. `tests/`, `scripts/` and `src/` stay out; `dist/` carries the build.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build

comment:build: `src/api.d.ts` is a DECLARATION file: tsc reads it and emits nothing for it, so the consumer contract would be missing from `dist` after a plain build. It is COPIED rather than pointed at from `src`, so `files` stays `dist`-only and `dist/index.d.ts`'s own `from './api.js'` resolves inside the published tree.
comment:dependencies: better-sqlite3 backs the FTS5 adapter; it already resolves from the repo root, so nothing new is installed — declared here so this package stays a liftable unit (decision N-1). `stemmer` is NOT optional: it is applied uniformly via processTerm to every adapter, so a missing one would silently change ranking rather than skip a leg. MIT, zero transitive deps (§IX round approved 2026-08-08).
comment:optionalDependencies: Adapter-gated packages, approved in the COMMON.md §IX round of 2026-08-08 (plan T-18 / T-20). Loaded by LAZY DYNAMIC IMPORT so an absent one skips its adapter instead of breaking the suite. The loader MUST catch ALL import errors, not just MODULE_NOT_FOUND: @lancedb/lancedb can fail at import time with a native BINDING error on a platform whose prebuilt binary lags the root version, and a narrow catch would hard-fail the suite instead of skipping the adapter. apache-arrow is @lancedb/lancedb's required peer.
